NavierStokes.OutgoingCone.exists_ordered:
NavierStokes.OutgoingCone.exists_ordered_profile_cone :
  ∃ M,
    0 < M ∧
      ∀ (m : ℝ),
        M ≤ m →
          ∀ (P : ℝ),
            NavierStokes.OutgoingEntranceCone.amplitudeThreshold m ≤ P →
              ∀ (K : ℝ),
                0 < K →
                  ∃ lam0,
                    0 < lam0 ∧
                      ∀ (F : NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.Profile),
                        F.data.core.P = P →
                          F.data.core.m = m →
                            F.coefficientBound = K →
                              F.data.core.wait = 60 * Real.log (1 / F.data.core.lam) →
                                F.data.core.lam < lam0 →
                                  F.data.h ≤ NavierStokes.OutgoingCone.heightThreshold m F.data.core.lam →
                                    ∀ left ≤ 0,
                                      ∃ XR0,
                                        0 < XR0 ∧
                                          ∀ (XR : ℝ), XR0 < XR → NavierStokes.OutgoingCone.ProfileCleanCone F XR left
